first_execution_warning.statement: This is the FIRST live execution of the current-day incremental path. All six slices of the three migration rounds ran as closed_date_reconciliation with a null floor, so the floor computation, the floor-reached pagination stop, and the separation of observed-high advance from date-checkpoint advance have never run against real data.
first_execution_warning.implication: Treat this as a genuine test, not a formality. A failure here is an expected possible outcome and must be reported honestly rather than retried.

mandatory_conditions: Stop on any failure: do not retry, do not adjust configuration, do not treat a failed run as a checkpoint seed; submit the failure evidence for adjudication as-is.

The evidence must explicitly report, for the current-day slice: mode (expected current_date_incremental), the computed incremental_floor_utc, whether the floor was reached, page_count, page_cap_hit, pagination_complete, the observed high before and after, and the date checkpoint before and after.
The date checkpoint must remain 2026-08-08. Report the value observed; do not correct it if it differs.

Continue the round-3 evidence schema: per-slice dispositions with identity checks, slice-to-source reconciliation, persisted-versus-process safety disclosure, executed source SHA-256, and expected-versus-observed scope binding.
A low announcement count is a legitimate outcome for a Sunday. Report it as observed; do not widen the window or treat a small day as a defect.

Because CNInfo batch-timestamps many announcements at 00:00 CST, the 30-minute overlap floor may never be reached and completeness may rest on pagination exhaustion. Report which mechanism actually terminated pagination.

Trading safety must hold throughout: trading_mode=research, live_trading_enabled=false, paper_trading_enabled=false, paper_auto_trading_enabled=false, futu_enable_account_mutation=false, futu_enable_trade=false, unlock_trade permanently blocked, zero non-SIMULATE broker orders, proposals and orders unchanged.
Do not modify, overwrite or reissue any existing evidence or authorization artifact; the new evidence file must be create-only.
